name: naukri-cli
description: CLI for searching jobs on Naukri.com (India). Unlike the other portal CLIs in this repo, Naukri's public search API is bot-protected (signed nkparam token + reCAPTCHA gating), so this drives a real headless Chromium via Playwright and captures the network response Naukri's own frontend JS produces, instead of reimplementing their token signing. Personal use only (Naukri ToS).
